item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi dgongs nyams 'phrul gyi me long
rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi dgongs nyams 'phrul gyis me long
item.coloph: dran pa nam mkha' nyid kyang skad cig gi shes pa/ thugs dgongs nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar gyur ste (te/)'khor 'das ma lus thig le nyag gcig tu rdzogs cing*/ ma 'ongs pa'i mngon shes thugs la gsal nas/ skye ba lnga brgya'i mkhyen par gyur to/ rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod lta ba'i klong las/ dgongs nyams 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba rdzogs s+ho//
